title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: which document type a documentation party may choose
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents policy governs the choice of document type (AHL Sea Waybill, AHL Electronic Bill of Lading, AHL Straight Bill of Lading, AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading, AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading, AHL Switch Bill of Lading) when a draft transport document is created from shipping instructions.

## Formal clauses

1. The document type is chosen by the documentation party in the shipping instructions and must fit the booking and the party.
2. The documentation party's customer role, as registered on the company's customer record, must be one of the roles the chosen tier admits.
3. For an AHL Electronic Bill of Lading, the documentation party must be enrolled on the eBL platform, as shown on its customer record.
4. A consignee printed as TO ORDER or TO ORDER OF a bank is allowed only on a tier that permits a to-order consignee; on other tiers the consignee must be a named company.
5. A place of receipt or place of delivery different from the ports is allowed only on a tier that permits an inland place of receipt.
6. A booking with collect freight may be documented only on a tier that permits collect freight, so an AHL Switch Bill of Lading always covers prepaid freight. The freight terms are read from the booking record.
7. The draft is sent within the tier's draft service standard, counted in hours from receipt of the shipping instructions.
8. A draft for an AHL Switch Bill of Lading is prepared only under the switch bill rules.
9. The document type cannot be changed on an existing document. A different type requires voiding the draft before issuance and creating a new draft, subject to the one-document-in-force-per-booking rule.

## Admission checklist for a new draft

| Check | Read from | Must show |
|---|---|---|
| Customer role | the documentation party's registered role | a role the chosen tier admits |
| eBL enrolment (AHL Electronic Bill of Lading only) | the customer record | enrolled |
| Consignee wording | the shipping instructions | TO ORDER wording only where the tier permits it; otherwise a named company |
| Place of receipt or delivery | the shipping instructions | inland places only where the tier permits them |
| Freight terms | the booking record | collect freight only where the tier permits it |

## Points of judgement

- **Hypothetical case:** a customer asks to turn an existing draft AHL Straight Bill of Lading into an AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading. The type of the existing document is not changed; the draft is voided before issuance and a new draft of the other type is created, provided every earlier document of the booking is then voided.
- The customer's own statement of its role or enrolment does not replace the customer record; the registered values decide.
